annotations.title: Save a comparison of digital plans

description: Saves 2 to 4 digital plans (plan ids from compare_digital / compare_mobile) as a private comparison in the signed-in person's account. Private: nobody else can open it until share_comparison makes a link.

items.description: A plan id of compare_digital / compare_mobile rows (e.g. claude-pro).

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.
